article: GNFSを超えるアルゴリズムは存在するのか
findings: Scoped RSA as one public-key system among several and GNFS as a well-known general-purpose classical method; removed claims that all Internet security would collapse or that GNFS is an established absolute fastest method.

Corrected heuristic expected L-notation estimates: CFRAC L_n[1/2,sqrt(2)], QS/MPQS L_n[1/2,1], and GNFS L_n[1/3,(64/9)^(1/3)]. Clarified these are not proven lower bounds or direct practical runtimes.

Removed claims that no L[1/4] algorithm is possible, fixed the matrix-kernel/nullspace wording, qualified sparse linear algebra methods and polynomial selection claims, and restored the five-phase GNFS process graph.

Removed unsupported RSA-2048 classical operation-count and quantum gate/time claims. Distinguished Gidney-Ekerå 2021 and Gidney 2025 resource estimates by their differing assumptions, and stated neither is a factoring demonstration.
Preserved publication date 2026-09-11 and set lastmod to 2026-11-23 in all 13 editions.
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Compared technical meaning, terminology, formulas, diagrams, links and claims against primary and academic sources; validated multilingual structure and math rendering.
